_comment: Seed list of company Greenhouse job-board tokens for the greenhouse source. The token is the slug in a board URL: https://boards.greenhouse.io/<token> (or boards-api.greenhouse.io/v1/boards/<token>/jobs). Add any company that hosts its careers page on Greenhouse. Override at runtime with GREENHOUSE_COMPANIES="tok1,tok2" or a data/greenhouse-companies.json file. Unknown/typo tokens simply 404 and are skipped.
